about_the_game:
Make your desktop come alive and express your style! Stunning video wallpapers, customizable mouse pointers, and flexible desktop icons—your desktop will never be boring again.

  • Dynamic Video Wallpapers: Bring your desktop to life with motion graphics, making every startup a fresh experience.

  • Personalized Desktop: Swap mouse pointer sets freely and customize desktop icons to suit your style.

  • Flexible Adaptation: Supports common screen ratios and multi-monitor setups, displaying video wallpapers naturally.

  • Workshop: Download incredible creations from players worldwide or share your own unique wallpapers.

  • Smart Performance Management: Wallpapers automatically pause during fullscreen games to keep your system smooth.

  • Easy Video Uploads: Set any video as your wallpaper in an instant.

Turn your desktop into more than a background—it’s your personal stage.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: 1.66 GHz Intel i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: HD Graphics 4000 or above
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 512 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz Intel i7 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660, AMD HD7870, 2 GB VRAM or above
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1024 MB available space

short_description: A dynamic Windows desktop app that brings your desktop to life, supporting video wallpapers, customizable mouse pointers and desktop icons, and allows sharing and downloading amazing wallpapers via the Workshop while maintaining multi-resolution, multi-monitor, and performance-friendly features.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Turkish, Japanese, Thai, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Spanish - Latin America, Vietnamese, Arabic, Korean
